transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Salieri! I’ve been away for two weeks on the Emperor’s business, trusting you to keep the rehearsals on schedule! The singers don’t know their entrances, the second violin parts are missing entirely, and someone has rewritten my stage directions without a word to me! The premiere is in ten days! You gave me your word that everything would be in order!

Please, allow me to investigate the matter and rectify the shortcomings that have befallen our production in your absence.

Let us first address the singers' lack of preparation. I shall meet with them immediately to ensure they are well-versed in their roles and entrances. As for the missing second violin parts, I will personally attend to the copying of these crucial components without delay. Rest assured, I shall see to it that the orchestra is equipped with all necessary materials for a successful performance.

Regarding the unauthorized alterations to your stage directions, I share in your dismay at such a breach of collaboration. It is essential that we work together in harmony to bring forth a coherent and unified artistic vision. I shall investigate the changes made and, if necessary, restore your original intentions to ensure the integrity of the production remains intact.

I understand the gravity of the situation with the premiere looming so near, but I give you my word that I will devote myself entirely to setting things right. Your trust in me was not misplaced, and I shall do everything in my power to honor that trust and deliver a performance of the highest caliber.

As for the missing parts, we require those ready by tomorrow morning. I will help with copying, but you must ensure the music is faultless. Our instruments cannot create harmony out of silence!

And whoever dared to alter my directions, find them and demand they explain themselves. We don’t have time for ego-driven changes in the eleventh hour when we crafted this performance with intent and care.

Get things in order, Salieri, and quickly, for the Emperor’s eye is watching, and we cannot afford to falter. Let us restore the trust and discipline that this production so desperately needs!
